source_priority: This module is authoritative for prisoner/ransom rules in V5.7.2-DEV and supersedes prisoner/ransom fields inherited from the V5.7.1 baseline snapshot.

human_vs_human.rule: Captor proposes N; prisoner owner accepts or rejects. The amount is negotiated by the players rather than selected from a fixed table.

ai.recipient_decision: AI prisoner owner independently evaluates the offer and accepts or rejects it.
